description:
An SSH public key of a `ForgejoUser` — typically a bot's. Same key
handling as `ForgejoDeployKey`; generated keys need `secretTargets` with
an explicit namespace (this CR is cluster-scoped).

deletionPolicy.description: What happens to the Forgejo object when its CR is deleted.

publicKey.description:
An OpenSSH public key (`ssh-ed25519 AAAA... comment`). Unset: the
operator generates an ed25519 pair.

secretTargets.description:
Destinations of a generated private key. Required when `publicKey`
is unset; a target that disappears (or a new
`forgejo.weebo.io/rotate-secret` nonce) generates a fresh pair.

items.description:
Where an emitted secret (generated password or key, OAuth2 credentials,
access token) is written. A CR may list several targets — the same
value is fanned out to each.

backend.description:
`kubernetes` (default) or `vault`. A Vault target reuses the
connection (address, mount, auth) of the instance's
`secretStore.vault`, which must then be set.

name.description:
Kubernetes: the `Secret` name. Vault: names the default path
`<pathPrefix>/<namespace>/<name>` when `path` is unset.

namespace.description:
Kubernetes `Secret` namespace (Vault: the namespace segment of the
default path). Defaults to the CR's own namespace; required on
cluster-scoped CRs.

path.description: Vault only: explicit KV v2 path under the instance's mount.

userRef.description:
Reference to another CR of this operator, by `metadata.name`. Always a
CR, never a raw remote name: a cluster-scoped target is looked up
cluster-wide, a namespaced one in the referencing CR's own namespace only.
